rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a good-quality blastocyst and acknowledges image limitations, but it introduces uncertain features (e.g., partial collapse/dark line, early hatching-type appearance) and questions the reported 3AA stage without strong visual basis.
Integrates age, endometriosis, AMH/FSH, prior low MII yield, endometrial thickness, sperm parameters, BMI, and lifestyle factors well, though some links to embryo-specific prognosis could be tighter.
Overall logic is mostly clear, but there are inconsistencies and speculative elements, including mixed statements about stage, fresh vs freeze-all planning, and some unsupported protocol suggestions.

Contains several nonstandard or weakly supported recommendations (e.g., avoiding transfer during pain, concern about gestational trophoblastic disease with DET, gestrinone/danazol-like agents, higher estradiol targets), despite otherwise reasonable support for SET and lifestyle optimization.

Provides practical next steps for transfer, lifestyle modification, luteal support adherence, review of trigger timing/MII yield, cavity evaluation, and future protocol review, though some recommendations are overly broad or speculative.
